content.text: The Mistake Almost Every Creator Makes First: Bitcoin payment

The mistake almost every creator makes is assuming that a third-party platform will always be available to process their payments. However, this is a flawed assumption that can lead to disaster. When a platform is taken down or restricts access, creators are left scrambling to find a new solution, resulting in lost sales and damaged relationships with customers. To avoid this, creators must prioritize building their own sovereign commerce infrastructure, giving them complete control over their sales and payment processing.
Why This Keeps Happening Even to Experienced Sellers

Even experienced sellers fall into this trap because they often prioritize convenience over control. They may choose to use a platform that handles payment processing for them, but this comes at a cost. By relying on someone else's infrastructure, creators are putting their business at risk. They must instead focus on building their own stack, using tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments to create a robust and reliable sales infrastructure that they own and control.
The Real Cost of Getting This Wrong

The real cost of getting this wrong can be devastating. Lost sales, damaged relationships, and a compromised reputation are just a few of the consequences of relying on a third-party platform. Moreover, when a platform is taken down, creators may also lose access to their customer data, making it difficult to recover and rebuild. By contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that creators retain ownership and control over their data, protecting their business from unforeseen disruptions.
Build your own stack to ensure sovereignty over your sales infrastructure.
How to Build the Stack That Cannot Be Taken Down

To build a stack that cannot be taken down, creators must focus on using open-source tools and decentralized technologies. This includes using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. By combining these tools with a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments, creators can build a robust and reliable sales infrastructure that is resistant to censorship and downtime.
The Infrastructure Decision That Changes Everything

The infrastructure decision that changes everything is the choice to prioritize sovereignty over convenience. By building their own commerce infrastructure, creators can ensure that they are always in control of their sales and payment processing. This decision requires an upfront investment of time and effort, but it pays off in the long run by providing a stable and reliable foundation for their business. With the right infrastructure in place, creators can focus on what they do best: creating and selling digital products to their customers.
